HediffDef.label: feeding-independent Wraith metabolism
HediffDef.description: This Wraith's Life Force metabolism has been successfully rewritten. It remains biologically and socially Wraith, but ordinary digestion has returned and feeding is no longer required. Without a Life Force reservoir, the old high-speed regenerative pathway is no longer powered.

HediffDef.label: feeding-independence vector rejection
HediffDef.description: The experimental metabolic rewrite failed. Competing Wraith, Iratus and retroviral signals are producing catastrophic multi-system inflammation. The crisis can burn itself out over several days, but death from organ failure is a serious risk.
